plan: Implemented all-feeds article fetching by injecting an optional FeedRepositoryProtocol into ArticleRepository, fetching enabled feeds, processing each through the existing per-feed path, and throwing a clear error if the dependency is missing instead of returning a stubbed empty result. Added focused ArticleRepository regression tests and wired the existing app construction sites to pass the feed repository. Validation was blocked by the sandbox: no generated Xcode workspace was present, CoreSimulator access failed, Tuist failed on a denied mkdir, and direct Swift typecheck failed because SwiftData macro plugin execution was denied.
